messages.content: Help me change the content of a div with the ID 'contentBox' and new content 'Hello World' by invoking the 'update' action?

function.name: contentUpdater
function.description: This function updates the inner content of a specified div element when the 'update' action is called. Note that the provided function is in JavaScript syntax.

elementID.description: The ID of the div element whose content is to be updated. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

newContent.description: The new content that will replace the current content of the div element. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.

action.description: The action to be performed. In this case, it should be 'update' to change the content. This is JavaScript String type parameter in string representation.
